LanguageData.MM_Reaver.label: Reaver
LanguageData.MM_Reaver.description: A siege warframe piloted by one colonist that also carries heavy cargo. Its missiles deal triple damage to buildings, and explosions can hit allies. It cannot fire while moving.\n\nIts ten-round magazine starts empty. Automatic fabrication makes one missile every 5 seconds for 150 light, even without a pilot or during caravan travel. Carries 2000 kg and travels at 4 world tiles per day. It can teleport with its pilot within the light network on the same map.
